title: Notes to the Belrose Circle Points Statement: Retention Periods by Tier
content:
# Notes to the Belrose Circle Points Statement — Retention Periods by Tier

Unspent points on a Belrose Circle Membership Programme membership are held for the expiry period the tier printed on the statement sets; the same tier sets the whole months without qualifying spend after which the membership lapses, whether unspent points are swept at the end of each membership year, whether unspent points fall away when the membership closes, and the calendar days after a sale within which points earned on it may be taken back on a return.

## Retention periods

| Tier | Unspent points fall away after (whole months) | Membership lapses after this many whole months without qualifying spend | Unspent points swept at membership year end | Unspent points fall away on closure | Reversal window after a sale (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 18 | 24 | No | Yes | 90 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 24 | 24 | No | Yes | 90 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 24 | 30 | No | Yes | 120 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 36 | 36 | No | Yes | 120 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 36 | 48 | No | No | 180 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 0 | 0 | No | No | 365 |

## Notes

- **Note 1 — expiry period.** Unspent points fall away after 18 whole months at Belrose Circle Member, after 24 whole months at Belrose Circle Silver and Belrose Circle Gold, and after 36 whole months at Belrose Circle Platinum and Belrose Circle Black. The Belrose Circle Founders' Club is the tier at which unspent points do not fall away with time; its expiry period is recorded as 0 whole months.
- **Note 2 — inactivity period.** The inactivity period after which a membership lapses for want of qualifying spend is 24 whole months at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver, 30 at Belrose Circle Gold, 36 at Belrose Circle Platinum and 48 at Belrose Circle Black; the figure recorded for the Belrose Circle Founders' Club is 0.
- **Note 3 — year-end sweep.** No tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme sweeps unspent points at the end of a membership year.
- **Note 4 — closure.** Unspent points fall away when the membership closes at Belrose Circle Member, Belrose Circle Silver, Belrose Circle Gold and Belrose Circle Platinum; at Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club they do not.
- **Note 5 — reversal window.** Points earned on a sale may be taken back on a return within 90 calendar days of the sale at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver, within 120 calendar days at Belrose Circle Gold and Belrose Circle Platinum, within 180 calendar days at Belrose Circle Black and within 365 calendar days at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.

## Reading the statement (hypothetical)

A statement headed Belrose Circle Gold carries an expiry period of 24 whole months, an inactivity period of 30 whole months, no year-end sweep, points falling away on closure, and a reversal window of 120 calendar days. A statement headed Belrose Circle Black carries 36, 48, no sweep, points preserved on closure, and 180 calendar days.
